info.title: radarge-api
info.description: Attendance and follow-up backend for Radarge.

get.summary: Whether the service is up and serving

post.summary: Exchange a username and password for a session
Rotate the refresh cookie and renew the access token
End the session on every device sharing its sign-in
Replace your own password, ending every session

get.summary: The caller's own profile
Every profile, by name
One profile

patch.description: A caller can never change their own role or deactivate themselves: an administrator who demotes themselves by accident locks the organisation out of its own system.

delete.summary: Remove a profile that leads no group and teaches no subject
delete.description: Deactivating with PATCH is the reversible option, and usually the right one.

get.summary: The students the caller may see
get.description: A teacher sees only students actively enrolled in a group they lead or teach in.

get.summary: One student the caller may see

delete.summary: Remove a student record and everything attached to it
delete.description: Deactivating with PATCH is almost always the right move: deleting takes the enrollments, attendance and grades with it.

get.summary: The groups the caller may see
One group the caller may see

delete.summary: Remove a group that holds no enrollment and no session

get.summary: Every subject, by name
One subject

delete.summary: Remove a subject that nothing references

get.summary: Enrollments in the groups the caller may see

post.summary: Enrol a student in a group
post.description: Idempotent. A student who left and came back reuses the original row, so the join date keeps saying when they first arrived.

delete.summary: Withdraw a student from a group
delete.description: A withdrawal is reversible and keeps the attendance already recorded: the link is deactivated, never deleted.

get.summary: Which subject a group studies, and who teaches it

post.summary: Give a group a subject and a teacher for it

patch.summary: Hand a subject to a different teacher

delete.summary: Stop teaching a subject in a group

get.summary: Roll calls in the groups the caller may see, newest first

post.summary: Open the roll call for a group on a day
post.description: Idempotent. Opening one that already exists returns it, so two teachers opening the same class at the same moment end up with one session rather than two.

get.summary: How each student was marked in one roll call

put.summary: Save the whole roll call at once
put.description: The screen saves the class in one call, inside one transaction. Only students actively enrolled in the group may be marked.

get.summary: Evaluations in the groups the caller may see, newest first

post.summary: Create an exam or a homework

patch.description: Its group and subject are fixed. Moving it elsewhere is a different evaluation, and the unique constraint already says so.

delete.summary: Remove an evaluation and the grades that belong to it

get.summary: Every grade on one evaluation

put.summary: Save the whole grade sheet at once
put.description: A null score means the grade is still pending, which is not a zero. Only students actively enrolled in the group may be graded.

get.summary: Weighted average per student and subject
get.description: Averages are weighted by each evaluation. A pending grade takes no part in the average: counting it as a zero would tell a family their child is failing a subject nobody has marked yet.

get.summary: Holidays, make-up days and events
get.description: A range returns every event overlapping it, not only those starting inside it.

post.summary: Add an event to the calendar

get.summary: Outings in the groups the caller may see, newest first

post.summary: Create an outing for a group
post.description: The title is unique within a group on a day.

delete.summary: Remove an outing and the marks that belong to it

get.summary: How each student was marked for one outing
get.description: A student with no row is pending on both marks. The roster comes from the enrolments, not from here.

put.summary: Set a student's authorization, payment, or both

get.summary: Percentage of attendance over the records the caller may see
get.description: Late counts as attendance; absent and excused do not. With no records at all the rate is 0 and `total` says why.

get.summary: Absence rate per day, oldest first
Students whose absences reach the threshold, most absences first
Average, area affinity, and the subjects that stand out either way
get.description: Weighting happens inside a subject. Averaging across subjects and areas is unweighted: a subject is not worth more for having been examined more often.
